rationale: This is clearly an auto collision claim: a motor vehicle caused damage to the policyholder's vehicle (totaled), and the policyholder sustained minor injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist).
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended at 8:15am on Route 9 yesterday at a red light, resulting in a totaled car with trunk crushed into the back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; other driver's insurance details are available in the police report. High severity due to vehicle total loss and injury component.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle going 35 mph with no braking; trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: Tree damage to a parked vehicle is covered under comprehensive auto coverage, not property damage or liability.
claim_summary: Riley Kim's parked car at her front driveway was struck by a falling maple tree during windstorm last night, causing significant damage to the hood and windshield. This is a comprehensive auto claim with estimated repair costs in the $3k–$8k range and a $1,000 deductible applies.

case_facts.description: maple tree from own yard fell in wind, damaged hood and windshield of parked car
